questions.question: What is the estimated total population of river dolphins in India as per the first-ever comprehensive survey?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**6,327**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s first-ever comprehensive river dolphin survey estimated presence of 6,327 river dolphins across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **first-ever comprehensive river dolphin survey** in India estimated a total of **6,327 river dolphins** across the country, with **635 dolphins** recorded in **Assam**.
 
• The river dolphin in Assam is called **Khihu**, and the survey was conducted under **Project Dolphin**.
 
• A **male Gangetic Dolphin** was **satellite tagged** in **Kulsi River near Guwahati**, marking a first in India and the world.
 
• **Assam’s Brahmaputra River** remains a stable and **barrier-free** habitat for river dolphins, while other rivers like the **Barak River** and **Subansiri River** show concerning signs of decline or extinction.
 
• The survey indicated that **Assam’s river systems** are critical for dolphin conservation, emphasizing the importance of **local community involvement** and the **protection of critical river habitats**.

 [IMAGE: https://www.newsonair.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/GlQc14qWoAAbYRb.jpg]

questions.question: What is the name of the new portal launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology to streamline Aadhaar authentication approvals?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Aadhaar Governance Portal​.**__

__
 
• **Aadhaar Governance Portal​ aims to simplify the approval process for Aadhaar authentication requests for both government and private entities.**

 __

• Responsible for issuing Aadhaar numbers and managing authentication services.

questions.question: Which country has become the second in the world to introduce digital pilot licenses, termed "Electronic Personnel License"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India becomes the second country to introduce digital pilot licenses (EPL) following ICAO's approval.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Union Minister for Civil Aviation, Ram Mohan Naidu, introduced the Electronic Personnel License (EPL), making India the second country to implement this after ICAO's approval.**
 
• **The EPL will be available digitally through the eGCA Mobile Application, replacing traditional physical licenses.**
 
• **The initiative aims to streamline the licensing process, improve security and transparency, and align with India’s “Ease of Doing Business” and “Digital India” vision.**
 
• **India’s aviation sector is rapidly expanding, and the introduction of EPL is expected to reduce the reliance on physical licenses, cutting delays and promoting sustainability.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO)__

 __
 
• ICAO is a specialized agency of the United Nations that promotes the safe and orderly development of international civil aviation.
 
• It sets standards and regulations necessary for the safety, security, efficiency, and environmental protection of international air transport.
 
 
 
• eGCA (Electronic General Civil Aviation)__
 __
 
• eGCA is an online platform developed by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) for issuing pilot licenses, which ensures a paperless process and digital verification of credentials.
 
 
 
• Plastic and Paper Usage Reduction__
 
 
• The shift from physical to digital licenses will significantly reduce the environmental footprint of the aviation industry by decreasing the use of plastic and paper materials.

questions.question: Where is India’s first cable-stayed rail bridge, Anji Khad Bridge, located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Anji Khad Rail Bridge** is India’s first cable-stayed rail bridge, located in Reasi district, Jammu and Kashmir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Part of the Udampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link (USBRL) Project**, the bridge aims to boost regional connectivity, economic development, and tourism.
 
• **Key Specifications**:
 
 
• Total length: **725.5 metres**.
 
• Main pylon height: **193 metres** above the foundation.
 
• Connects **Katra and Reasi**, easing travel between these locations.
 
 
 
• **Engineering Challenges**:
 
 
• The region's geological features, including faults, folds, and seismic activity, posed significant construction challenges.
 
• IIT Roorkee and Delhi conducted detailed investigations, leading to a **hybrid foundation** at the Katra end for stability.
 
 
 
• **Structural Details**:
 
 
• Consists of four sections:
 
 
• **120-metre ancillary viaduct** on Reasi side.
 
• **38-metre approach bridge** on Katra end.
 
• **473.25-metre main cable-stayed portion**.
 
• **94.25-metre central embankment**.
 
 
 
• **Deck width**: 15 metres, accommodating a **single railway line**, a **service road**, and **footpaths**.
 
 
 
• **Advanced Construction Techniques**:
 
 
• **DOKA Jump form shuttering** and **pump concreting systems** sped up construction by 30%.
 
• A **state-of-the-art tower crane** from Spain was used for high-altitude work up to 193 metres.
 
 
 
• **Safety Features**:
 
 
• Equipped with an **integrated monitoring system** using sensors to ensure structural health.
 
• Designed to withstand **wind speeds up to 213 km/h**.

questions.question: Which national park in Madhya Pradesh has been designated as India's 58th Tiger Reserve?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhav National Park.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Madhav National Park in Madhya Pradesh has been designated as India's 58th Tiger Reserve.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhav National Park is located in the Shivpuri district of Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• It was previously a hunting ground for the Scindia Maharajas of Gwalior and was notified as a national park in 1958.
 
• The park spans 355 square kilometers and is part of the Upper Vindhyan Hills.
 
• Madhav National Park features diverse landscapes, including forests, grasslands, and lakes like Sakhya Sagar and Madhav Sagar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Panna National Park__

 __
 
• Located in Madhya Pradesh, it was declared a Tiger Reserve in 1994.
 
• It is famous for its successful tiger reintroduction program.
 
 
 
• Satpura National Park__
 __
 
• Situated in Madhya Pradesh, it was established in 1981.
 
• It is known for its rugged terrain and high biodiversity.
 
 
 
• Kanha National Park__
 
 
• Located in Madhya Pradesh, it was declared a Tiger Reserve in 1973 under Project Tiger.

questions.question: Which two Indian cities were recently added to the Global Wetland Cities list for integrating wetland preservation into their urban plans?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore and Udaipur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indore and Udaipur have joined the exclusive group of 31 cities worldwide recognized for their wetland preservation efforts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indore:** Known for cleanliness and innovative policies, houses Sirpur Lake, a Ramsar site.
 
• **Udaipur:** Known as the "City of Lakes," has five major wetlands: Pichola, Fateh Sagar, Rang Sagar, Swaroop Sagar, and Doodh Talai.
 
• Both cities are recognized for integrating wetland preservation into urban development plans.
 
• The Global Wetland Cities list now features 31 cities worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Sirpur Lake:__ A Ramsar site located in Indore, known for its biodiversity and environmental importance.
 
• __Udaipur:__ Renowned for its picturesque lakes, crucial for tourism and water management.
 
• __Global Wetland Cities List:__ An initiative by the Ramsar Convention to recognize cities promoting sustainable wetland management.
 
• __Ramsar Sites:__ Wetlands of international importance under the Ramsar Convention, aimed at conservation and sustainable use.

questions.question: From which year will the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) start conducting Class-10 board exams twice a year, as per the approved draft norms?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 2026

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **CBSE plans to conduct Class X board exams twice a year from 2026** to help students improve performance, aligning with the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020** recommendations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The proposal was **discussed with the education ministry**, and a **draft policy has been uploaded on CBSE’s website** for stakeholder feedback.
 
• **Stakeholders must submit feedback by March 9, 2025**, after which the policy will be **finalized**.
 
• **In 2026, exams will be conducted in two phases:** February 17 – March 6 and May 5 – 20, spanning **34 days**.
 
• **Science, social science, mathematics, Hindi, and English exams will be held on fixed days**, while **regional and foreign languages will be conducted on a single day**.
 
• Practical and internal assessments will be **conducted only once**, and the **final candidate list will be locked in September 2025**.
 
• **No new candidates can register for the May 2026 exam** unless they are on the **September 2025 list**.
 
• The **final marksheet will be issued after the May exam**, featuring **both attempts and the best score for each subject**.
